Container.Name: rapidforge
Container.Overview: RapidForge is a self-hosted automation platform that lets you run scripts, schedule tasks, manage credentials, and build lightweight internal tools — all from a clean web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the RapidForge web interface.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite databases and application data.

Config.Name: Environment
Config.Description: Application environment. Keep as 'production' for normal use.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Path to the main SQLite database file.

Config.Name: KV Store URL
Config.Description: Path to the key-value SQLite database file.

Config.Name: Domain
Config.Description: The domain or IP address where RapidForge is accessible (e.g. 192.168.1.100 or myserver.local).

Config.Name: Port (env)
Config.Description: Internal port used by the Go server. Must match the container port (default :8080).

Config.Name: Load Balancer
Config.Description: Set to true if RapidForge is behind a reverse proxy/load balancer (strips port from base URL).

Config.Name: TLS Certificate
Config.Description: Optional PEM-encoded certificate + private key bundle for TLS termination inside the container.
